summary: Marikina City 2nd District representative with 81 principal-authored bills. Authored a universal social pension, universal health care amendments, a tax credit for physicians, an estate tax amnesty extension, petroleum excise suspension powers, a plastic excise, a VAT exemption on system-loss charges, improved excise tax administration and an anti-dynasty bill.
caveat: Anti-dynasty is a single institutions issue and unscored. Some bill titles were truncated by the extractor.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a universal social pension (-3) and universal health care amendments (-3), against tax items near neutral: physician tax credit, estate tax amnesty and petroleum excise suspension (+1 to +2), plastic excise and VAT on system loss (-1).
